'''Zenoti Arms''' was a weapons manufacturer operating during the era of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One of its notable creations was the [[HB-9 rifle|HB-9 blaster rifle]].

Zenoti Arms specialized in the manufacture of ornate [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]]. This company was possibly based on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], where the HB-9 was wielded by local resistance forces during the Clone Wars.
